name: git_integration
description: Wraps core/githelper.py's git integration as CCOS capabilities — read-only repo inspection plus mutating commit/branch/merge/push operations

capabilities.name: coding.git_is_repo
capabilities.description: Check whether a path is inside a git repository

capabilities.name: coding.git_status
capabilities.description: Return short-form git status for a repo

capabilities.name: coding.git_log
capabilities.description: Return the last n commits in oneline format

capabilities.name: coding.git_current_branch
capabilities.description: Return the name of the current branch

capabilities.name: coding.git_branches
capabilities.description: List all local and remote-tracking branches with current branch marked

capabilities.name: coding.git_detect_conflicts
capabilities.description: Return the list of files with unresolved merge conflicts

capabilities.name: coding.git_conflict_sections
capabilities.description: Parse a file's git conflict markers and extract 'ours'/'theirs' sections

capabilities.name: coding.git_diff_for_commit
capabilities.description: Get a truncated diff (staged, then unstaged, then last commit) suitable for commit-message generation

capabilities.name: coding.git_commit_log_messages
capabilities.description: Return the last n commit subject lines

capabilities.name: coding.git_generate_commit_message
capabilities.description: Use the inference engine to generate a commit message from a diff and recent history (loads the model — do not call in lightweight contexts)

capabilities.name: coding.git_commit
capabilities.description: Stage (optional) and commit changes with a message. Mutates repo state.

capabilities.name: coding.git_push
capabilities.description: Push the current branch to its remote. Mutates remote state.

capabilities.name: coding.git_branch_create
capabilities.description: Create a new branch and switch to it. Mutates repo state.

capabilities.name: coding.git_checkout
capabilities.description: Switch to an existing branch. Mutates repo state.

capabilities.name: coding.git_merge
capabilities.description: Merge a branch into the current branch. Mutates repo state.

author: CCOS
